request.text: I want the new Wi-Fi version of the Xiaomi Redmi Pad 2, 8 GB RAM and 256 GB storage. What would one cost delivered to Tripoli?

message:
The clearest delivered price is Electroslab: $275.00, with free delivery to Tripoli under its website promotion through Nov 30 (orders of $20 or more). The listing confirms Redmi Pad 2 Wi-Fi, 8GB/256GB, gray, with a cover—but does not explicitly confirm brand-new condition.
Other in-stock options:
• OutGeeked: $265.00 for the exact 8GB/256GB Wi-Fi configuration; delivery fee and new condition unconfirmed.
• Abed Tahan: $245.00 for an 8GB/256GB Pad 2; Wi-Fi connectivity, new condition and delivery fee remain unconfirmed.
I’d favor Electroslab for the documented delivered cost, provided you verify it is brand new before ordering.
